start.title: The Door in the Alley
start.text: It’s raining. You spot a door you’ve never seen before—half hidden behind a flickering neon sign. It feels like it’s waiting for you.

walk_past.title: You Keep Walking
walk_past.text: You decide not to risk it. Two steps later, you hear the door click open behind you… by itself.

run.title: Full Sprint
run.text: You run. The city blurs. When you stop, you’re in a different street… but the same door is there again.

door_open.title: The Quiet Shop
door_open.text: Inside is a tiny shop with shelves of jars labeled with impossible things: ‘Tuesday’, ‘Bravery’, ‘The Last Snowfall’. A bell rings softly.

ask.title: The Shopkeeper Smiles
ask.text: A voice from behind the counter says: “You can trade a memory for something you need.” You’re not sure if you believe it… but you are sure you want to.

luck.title: Luck, Uncorked
luck.text: The jar is warm. When you open it, the room brightens, like the world remembered how to be kind. Outside, the rain stops.

small_trade.title: A Fair Deal
small_trade.text: You trade the memory of a boring afternoon. In return, you receive a tiny bottle labeled ‘Calm’. Your shoulders drop for the first time in weeks.

big_trade.title: The Price of Need
big_trade.text: You trade a precious memory. The shopkeeper nods solemnly and hands you ‘Courage’. You feel fearless… and strangely hollow.

greedy.title: Too Much
greedy.text: You reach for another jar—‘Forever’. The shelves rattle. The bell rings like a warning. The lights dim.

outside.title: Back to the City
outside.text: You step outside. The alley is gone. The neon sign is gone. But something in you is different now—lighter, sharper, braver.

end_bad.title: Forever
end_bad.text: The moment you take it, the world freezes—beautiful and silent. You got ‘Forever’. Now you have to live inside it.
